title: Sahel Agro-Pastoral Drought Resilience Input Subsidy
organization: FAO Sahel Initiative & Kano State Ministry of Agriculture
actionable_steps: Obtain your verified Farmer Cooperative Registration Slip from your Ward Agriculture Extension Officer.
Visit the Dawanau Agricultural Desk (Desk #4, Old Market Road) between 08:00 and 13:00 on Tuesdays or Thursdays.
Present physical NIN slip and cooperative membership letter; biometric verification is waived for low-connectivity zones.
Collect allocation voucher for 2x50kg drought-resistant sorghum seed bags and solar water-pump voucher.

title: Community Land Title & Pastoralist Corridor Legal Aid
organization: OSF Africa × Kaduna Community Legal Aid Network
actionable_steps: File a community dispute notice with the Village Head (Mai Angwa) to record the traditional grazing corridor boundary.
Attend the free mobile legal clinic hosted every alternate Saturday at the Kachia Civic Center.
Meet pro-bono counsel to draft a Statutory Right of Occupancy representation or traditional arbitration deed.
Receive court-stamped protection order guaranteeing safe transit without retaliatory boundary encroachment.

title: Sahel Grassroots Youth Peace & Livelihood Micro-Grant
organization: OSF Transformative Peace × Borno Youth Alliance
actionable_steps: Form an informal community cohesion group with at least 5 youth members (ages 18-35).
Document a 1-page civic peace proposal addressing community early warning, market security, or borehole maintenance.
Submit physical application to the Maiduguri Civil Society Hub (Opposite State Library, Post Office Area).
Shortlisted groups receive a ₦450,000 cash grant disbursed directly through postal draft or agent banking.

title: Rural Women Solar Borehole & Cooperative Farming Scheme
organization: Sahel Women Development Fund & Local CBO Consortium
actionable_steps: Register with the Local Ward Women Leader (Magajiya) in your ward.
Provide proof of continuous residency (voter card or traditional endorsement letter from Mai Angwa).
Attend the communal water rights management workshop at the Ward Primary Health Clinic.
Receive certified membership pass for priority access to solar irrigation plots and monthly seed distribution.

title: Primary Health Clinic Essential Drug Supply Oversight
organization: Kano Civil Society Forum & OSF Africa Health Watch
actionable_steps: Inspect the monthly drug allocation chalkboard at your Ward Primary Health Center (PHC).
If anti-malarials or maternal vitamins are reported 'out of stock' while logged on the board, request the Ward Development Committee (WDC) logbook.
Present this verified notice to the Village Head or text the anonymized code to the community oversight board at Gwarzo Secretariat.
The oversight desk dispatches a physical verification auditor within 48 hours.

title: Solar Grain Milling Cooperative Equipment Scheme
actionable_steps: Verify that your local women's or youth farming group comprises at least 8 verified grain growers.
Obtain an attestation of communal land grant (minimum 10m x 10m plot) from the Funtua District Head.
Submit group application slip to the KTADP Zonal Office in Funtua.
Qualifying cooperatives receive installation of a zero-emission solar diesel-substitute grain mill with 3-year warranty.

title: Community Radio Early-Warning & Peace Reporter Stipend
organization: Sahel Peace Media & Build Up Peacebuilding Lab
actionable_steps: Submit two written or voice-recorded examples of peaceful dispute de-escalation in your rural community.
Attend the 1-day safety and ethical reporting seminar at the Kaduna Media Academy.
Receive a solar battery pack, encrypted feature voice recorder, and monthly ₦75,000 reporting stipend.
File weekly communal harmony radio reports broadcast on local FM stations in Hausa and Fulfulde.

title: Pastoralist Livestock Vaccination & Water Point Access
organization: Borno Livestock Services & Regional Veterinary Health Fund
actionable_steps: Register herd count with the Miyetti Allah or pastoralist elder representative at the Damboa cattle transit station.
Present cattle for free contagious bovine pleuropneumonia (CBPP) vaccination tags.
Collect the seasonal transhumance corridor transit pass allowing unrestricted access to certified community boreholes.
Keep the laminated stamp card accessible to present peacefully at any local grazing dispute committee.
